method: Dumped callers for the known send-helper inventory, decompiled the unique callers, classified packet builders by opcode/size literals at send-helper call sites, then BFS-walked caller-list edges backward up to depth 5 looking for Control-class Lua N-API impl VAs.
conclusion: Reverse-BFS recovered 8 existing direct binding and added 1 catalog-confirmed direct-emission bindings.
